seed_convention: reset key = jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); raw key at step i = jax.random.fold_in(reset_key, i+1); prospective only.

scripts.scope: Prospective finite replay of actual reset/raw_step states
scripts.intended_objective: Attempt an eastbound shared fill for boats 0 and 1, yield the high approach with boat 2, then drain for boat 2 westbound return. All-three delivery is an untested intention.
scripts.legality_claim: All integers are declared command attempts for active roles. Stop at joint completion and replace no remaining actions; dynamic legality and outcomes have not been executed or certified.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Paired raw trajectories from the identical reset key and literal shared prefix; replay both suffixes without policy learning.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Branch A commits both service-water units to the upper chamber before the same lower-boat fill attempt. Intended effect: the lower level remains zero in A but rises in B. Boat 1 actions and seed are unchanged; inspect actual water conservation in both traces.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: Both branches can have no deliveries and equal delivery reward.
Extra upper pump-attempt costs may make branch A worse for boat 0 over the measured suffix.
If a gate or control-position prerequisite failed, the predicted level contrast can be absent.
A short resource contrast does not establish which convoy order yields better eventual returns.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_rule: Record actual state/observation/action identities and both trajectories. Report intended effects as absent, negative, mixed, failed or indeterminate if that is what execution shows; do not replace the action script after observing a result.
